title: DeckFile
description: A story chapter's outer-layer cards (design doc 4.2 and 7.2, build plan P1): the 2 to 3 cards played before the chapter opens, and the event cards a Trigger with event "card" shows inside it. Card and option text is in content/strings under deck.<chapter>.<card>.title, deck.<chapter>.<card>.<option> and deck.<chapter>.<card>.<option>.note. Cross-file checks (the chapter exists, effects name card or event tags, every combination of opening cards can finish the chapter) are in tools/check-decks.ts.

chapter.description: The chapter id; also the file name.

opening.description: Played in order before the first room. Empty for a chapter whose premise is fixed (the prologue).

events.description: Shown when the operator steps on a Trigger whose event is card and whose eventId is the card id.

effect.description: What choosing it does, in the effect language of the dialogue CSV: tag:x, tag:x=n, tag:x+n, clock:minutes, unlock:page, separated by ;. Empty does nothing. Opening cards may set tags whose sources include card, event cards those whose sources include event.
